spans.s: (prob. fr. मीन) a kind of gait or movement, Saṃgīt.

N. of a mountain (son of Hima-vat by Menā or Menakā, and said to have alone retained his wings when Indra clipped those of the other mountains; accord. to some this mountain was situated between the southern point of the Indian peninsula and Laṅkā), TĀr. (v.l. मैनाग॑), AV.Pariś.; MBh. &c.
मैनाक—प्रभव m. N. of the river Śoṇa, VP.
